groups.label: Neck
groups.description: Talar neck fracture patterns with risk to subtalar alignment and talar body vascularity.

variants.label: Nondisplaced neck
variants.description: Talar neck fracture without displacement or joint subluxation.

variants.label: Displaced neck
variants.description: Displaced talar neck fracture with subtalar incongruity.

variants.label: Neck with dislocation
variants.description: Talar neck fracture with subtalar, tibiotalar, or talonavicular dislocation.

treatments.label: Protected immobilization
treatments.main_indications: Strictly nondisplaced fracture confirmed by appropriate imaging.

treatments.label: Dual-approach ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Displaced talar neck fracture requiring anatomic reduction of neck and articular alignment.

treatments.label: Anterolateral approach
treatments.main_indications: Lateral neck access, combined reduction windows, or screw trajectory planning.

groups.label: Body
groups.description: Talar body fracture involving ankle or subtalar articular surfaces.

variants.label: Sagittal split
variants.description: Body split pattern affecting tibiotalar congruity.

variants.label: Coronal / posterior body
variants.description: Posterior body or coronal shear pattern.

variants.label: Comminuted body
variants.description: Multifragmentary talar body fracture with high osteonecrosis risk.

treatments.label: Medial malleolar osteotomy
treatments.main_indications: Medial talar body exposure when direct joint access is required.

treatments.label: Lateral malleolar osteotomy
treatments.main_indications: Lateral talar body exposure or combined access for complex articular fracture.

treatments.label: Osteonecrosis surveillance
treatments.main_indications: Post-injury and post-fixation risk counseling and follow-up planning.

groups.label: Process
groups.description: Lateral, posterior, or head/process talar fractures.

variants.label: Lateral process
variants.description: Lateral process fracture affecting subtalar joint congruity.

variants.label: Posterior process
variants.description: Posterior process fracture, medial or lateral tubercle.

variants.label: Head / combined process
variants.description: Talar head or combined process injury.

treatments.label: Direct lateral approach
treatments.main_indications: Lateral process fracture requiring reduction or excision.

treatments.label: Posterolateral hindfoot approach
treatments.main_indications: Posterior process fracture requiring posterior access.

treatments.label: Posteromedial approach
treatments.main_indications: Medial posterior process or posteromedial talar body access.
